dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS. Heavy use of COPY and CALL. Japanese EUC or Shift-JIS encoded comments (decoded as latin-1).
evidence: no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/rezept) processing system — ORCA (JMA standard receipt software). This module appears to handle point aggregation/calculation by diagnosis category for medical receipts.
purpose.summary: ORCR0030 is a large batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that computes and edits point (score) totals broken down by diagnosis/treatment category for insurance claim receipts. It processes various medical billing rules including outpatient management fees, prescription fees, examination counts, and partial-payment amounts across multiple insurance types.

notable_features: 47 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
539 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP/Shift-JIS encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
Long comment header with JMA Open Source License notice
verdict.notes: File is 689KB / 14287 lines — a very large production program. Comments are in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but were decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake. The program belongs to the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. Source was truncated to first 16000 chars; full procedure division not visible but mechanical indicators confirm all four divisions present.
